confirmedSource: YouTubeWorkspace Cover uses one global4-active thumbnail queue. YouTubePortrait uses a separate2-active queue. Both invoke youtube_thumbnail, whose native4-slot try_acquire can immediately return the fixed busy error.

Both frontend callers catch failure as null. They cache successes only, not failures. However the mounted effect is not retried with unchanged identity/dependencies after its observer disconnects; a single transient busy/failure therefore leaves the placeholder indefinitely.
Cover has no active-view input or queued unsubscribe, so requests queued in Explore can continue while newly visible drawer portraits enter. No native account/URL-policy failure is proved.

Portrait receives actionApi (a shallow API copy) while Cover uses api. A shared queue keyed by API object would remain split. The exact thumbnail function identity is shared by these copies and can key one source-local transport queue.
minimalProposal: One YouTube-local subscription helper keyed by exact thumbnail function identity, bounded4 active/128 queued/128 success cache/10minute TTL. Cover and Portrait delegate to it. Cache video/channel IDs remain distinct; no author image substituted with video cover.

Pass actual visible Explore/Favorites active state to Cover. Unsubscribe on inactive/private/identity/unmount and remove unstarted queued work; running IPC keeps its occupied slot until real completion. Stale callbacks cannot update current item. Do not fake cancellation or start new work before an in-flight call settles.

Keep native semaphore/host/CSP/image policies unchanged. Only youtube_thumbnail returns a closed error code busy or unavailable with existing safe display message. API normalizes the exact object to a source-local error; queue retries only busy at250ms and750ms, at most3 physical calls total per request. Null, malformed image, unavailable, unknown and locale-only strings are terminal for that subscription. Timers remain bounded by pending128 and cancel with the last listener; no slot is freed before its underlying call settles.

Before claiming this actual Lofi Girl failure fixed, root should run one exact anonymous native read_channel opt-in test for this canonical channel and confirm the actual image renders in refreshed app. Tests may project only presence/dimensions/bytes/fixed stage; no raw HTML/URL/account data.
